subtitle: Assassin Dominion & Verified Connected Player
changes: Refreshed the companion with the dark Assassin Dominion theme, custom artwork, app icons and iPhone Home Screen support.
Improved navigation on PC and iPhone with adaptive sidebar scrolling, bottom navigation, responsive layouts and accessibility.
Added a searchable Command Launcher with favorites, recent tools and Ctrl/Cmd+K shortcut.
Introduced the Unified Character Dashboard for locally tracked item targets, loot goals and farming activity.
Implemented secure Battle.net connection verification through short-lived Cloudflare receipts; no OAuth tokens are exposed to GitHub Pages.
Corrected verification for Battle.net accounts without World of Warcraft characters or account collection data.
Added a Connected Player view with verified region, last check, expiration countdown and one-click recheck; verification is revalidated after refresh.
Restored coherent release metadata so successful validated Azeroth version updates can trigger automated Discord announcements.
